newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Ford resumes output in Portugal after strike.
newsitem.headline: Ford resumes output in Portugal after strike.

text.p: U.S. carmaker Ford has resumed normal production at a Portuguese factory after a one-day stoppage caused by a strike by Spanish truck drivers, a spokesman said.
"We have been producing normally since yesterday," Artur Lemos told Reuters.

The Ford factory at Azambuja, 30 kilometres (19 miles) north of Lisbon, had ceased production of Ford Transit vans on Wednesday because of a dire shortage of parts held up by the strike. The factory normally produces 50 vehicles per day.
Opel Portugal, a unit of U.S. carmaker General Motors, said on Thursday it had resumed output of Opel Combo and Opel Corsa vans at its Azambuja factory after a one-day stoppage on Wednesday.
